source: LP duality certificate (spec 2 'Benchmark definitions', transport): the plan meets every limit; dual prices u = (0, -3, -2) for the supply limits of north, centre and south and v = (4, 6, 6, 5) for the demand limits of city, harbour, park and market satisfy u <= 0, v >= 0 and cost - u - v >= 0 on every route, with equality on the six used routes; the plan's cost 2,690 equals the dual value -600 - 500 + 720 + 1,320 + 900 + 850 = 2,690, so it is optimal; the unused routes' reduced costs 3, 6, 2, 6, 4 and 4 are positive, so it is unique; checked by tests/benchmarks/test_transport_certificate.py, M10
